docs_description: A component library for SolidJS built with Ark UI, Tailwind CSS, and TanStack.
docs_component_accordion_description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that reveal content.
docs_component_alert_dialog_description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content.
docs_component_aspect_ratio_description: Displays content within a desired ratio.
docs_component_avatar_description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.
docs_component_badge_description: A small label component for status or counts.
docs_component_button_description: A clickable button component with multiple variants.
docs_component_typography_description: Text components for consistent typography styling.
